sections.0.body.0.t: Instead of a security team that reviews everything at the end (and becomes a bottleneck), security engineering builds the platform that makes secure behavior the default: ready-made modules, templates, pipelines, libraries and checks, with documentation and support, offered as an internal product.

sections.1.body.0.t: The paved path (golden path) is the recommended way to do something: create a new service, publish an image, provision a database. Whoever follows it gets encryption, logs, policies and pipeline configured for free. Whoever leaves it can, but takes on the cost and goes through review. This changes the incentive: security stops being a tax and becomes the shortcut.

sections.2.bullets.0.t: Adoption: percentage of services using the approved template or module.

sections.2.bullets.1.t: Coverage: percentage of repositories with SAST, SCA and secret scanning enabled.

sections.2.bullets.2.t: Time to onboarding: how long it takes a new team to be within the standard.

sections.2.bullets.3.t: Friction: time added to the pipeline per control, and the false positive rate perceived by devs.

sections.2.bullets.4.t: Time to fix: from discovering a finding to fixing it, by severity.

sections.3.body.0.t: Every control that blocks without explaining, is slow or is wrong becomes a reason to bypass the platform. Clear messages (what failed, why and how to fix it), automatic remediation when possible and exceptions with an expiry reduce friction. If devs are turning a control off, the product problem is the control, not the devs.

sections.4.body.0.t: The platform has users and, therefore, targets: availability of the security pipeline, latency of the checks, response time to exception requests. Treating these numbers as a goal, rather than chance, is what gives security engineering credibility in front of the other teams.

short.t: the secure path must be the easiest path

tagline.t: Controls that get in the way are bypassed. A security platform that treats devs as customers, with a paved path, adoption metrics and low friction, is the one that actually protects.
